Backend Developer.title: Backend Developer
Backend Developer.description: Designs server-side logic, RESTful APIs, database architectures, and cloud services.

learning_path.focus: Master core syntax, OOP, and async programming.
Learn complex queries, indexing, and ORMs (SQLAlchemy).
Build web APIs with FastAPI / Flask.
Manage branches, pull requests, and Git workflows.
Containerize backend microservices for cloud deployment.

Data Analyst.title: Data Analyst
Data Analyst.description: Inspects, cleans, transforms, and models data to discover useful information and support decision-making.

learning_path.focus: Master Python data structures and control flow.
Query data tables, aggregations, and joins.
Data cleaning, transformation, and statistical summary.
Build interactive executive dashboards.
Hypothesis testing, regression, and trends.

AI Engineer.title: AI Engineer
AI Engineer.description: Builds, deploys, and maintains artificial intelligence and machine learning models for production applications.

learning_path.focus: Scientific computing with NumPy & Pandas.
Supervised/unsupervised algorithms with scikit-learn.
Text processing, tokenization, and NLP pipelines.
Neural networks, loss functions, and optimization.
Expose trained AI models via FastAPI REST endpoints.

Full Stack Developer.title: Full Stack Developer
Full Stack Developer.description: Handles both client-side user interfaces and server-side backend application development.

learning_path.focus: Responsive web layouts and modern styling.
DOM manipulation, async/await, and event handling.
Component state, hooks, and SPA architecture.
RESTful endpoints and database connection.
Connect frontend components with SQL backends.

DevOps Engineer.title: DevOps Engineer
DevOps Engineer.description: Bridges software development and IT operations to automate infrastructure, deployment, and testing.

learning_path.focus: Command line, bash scripting, file permissions.
Repository workflows and automated hooks.
Write Dockerfiles and compose multi-container stacks.
Automate testing and builds using GitHub Actions.
Manage cloud servers, networking, and Kubernetes.
